skills.skill_desc: <font color="a6aafb">Scripture of the Moon Elf</font> gradually charges energy into Estes. Upon reaching 100 stacks, Estes' next Basic Attack is enhanced, dealing 250<font color="fba51f"> (+100% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+150% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to the target. The enhanced attack also bounces to nearby enemies, dealing 125<font color="fba51f"> (+50% Total Physical Attack)</font> <font color="62f8fe">(+75% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to nearby enemies and slowing them by 60% for 1.5s.

Estes immediately recovers 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+110% Total Magic Power)</font> HP for the target allied hero and links himself with them for 5s.
While linked, both heroes gain 15<font color="62f8fe"> (+10% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="26e407"><1999></font>, and the target slowly recovers 360<font color="62f8fe"> (+90% Total Magic Power)</font> HP. The link increases Estes' Movement Speed by 15% and the energy charge rate of the <font color="a6aafb">Scripture of the Moon Elf</font>.
The link breaks if Estes moves too far from the target.

Estes calls down a flood of moonlight on the target area, dealing 350<font color="62f8fe"> (+70% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemy units within it.

The area then becomes a <font color="a6aafb">Domain of Moon Goddess</font>, revealing enemies within. Enemies that touch the domain's edge are slowed by 90% for 1.5s. The slow effect decays over time.

Estes casts an enhanced <font color="a6aafb">Moonlight Immersion</font> on himself and all nearby allied heroes, refreshing <font color="a6aafb">Moonlight Immersion</font> on them and enhancing it for 8s.
Enhanced <font color="a6aafb">Moonlight Immersion</font>: Doubles the Instant Basic Healing and <font color="26e407"><1999></font> Increase, and heals the target for 1020<font color="62f8fe"> (+225% Total Magic Power)</font> HP over time.
